options.prompt: Create realistic, production-quality UI design with clear hierarchy, strong typography, intentional imagery and purposeful spacing. Single mobile web app START screen at 390 x 844 logical dimensions, portrait app content only. No device bezel, OS/status bar, mockup frame, browser chrome, or comparison collage. Korean relationship compatibility service for adults including older users. Concept name: 인연 우체부. Two ORIGINAL plump small birds, one teal and one apricot, deliver a tiny envelope between them; exquisite softly textured editorial illustration on warm ivory, dark ink text, deep teal main button. Attached competitor screenshot is ONLY moodboard evidence of friendly character introduction; DO NOT copy hamster, hat, pink branding, composition, text, or assets. Build an original coherent visual identity. Layout: minimal wordmark '가까운 사이' top left (working title), small supporting '내 지도' right, large left aligned headline near top '나와 이 사람,\n어떤 사이일까요?', two line supporting copy '생년월일로 알아보는\n우리 사이의 좋은 점', generous original bird art as central focus, flat numbered simple horizontal three-step line '내 정보 → 상대 정보 → 우리 궁합', bottom large primary button '첫 상대 무료로 보기', beneath clear pricing '다음 상대부터 1명당 2,900원'. Exactly one primary action. Body 18–20px equivalent, headings 30–32px, button height 56px or more, high contrast, ample whitespace. No nested cards, decorative metrics, tabs, unnecessary panels, horoscope store or chatbot. No invented compatibility scores. Current date anchor 2026-10-13; no dates need shown. Design should be practical to implement in Next.js, full bleed page surface, no clipping.

Create realistic production-quality UI design: a SINGLE focused primary mobile web START screen for Korean relationship compatibility app. Logical dimensions 390 x 844, portrait app content only, no device bezel, no OS bar or browser, no multiple panels or comparison collage. Warm cream, restrained pale sage and terracotta, dark espresso Korean text. Flat hand-painted storybook illustration with clean contemporary product typography. Attached competitor screenshot is inspiration ONLY for friendliness; never copy its character, pink branding, city tea scene, text, layout or proprietary assets. This is a practical Next.js mobile website concept, not a poster. Date anchor 2026-10-13, no dates shown.
